basis: C4 PEP carboxylase (UniProt C5Z451); paper annotation marker; pseudobulk 12h M 40.3 vs BS 6.9 (SuppT9); M DE log2FC 1.23 (SuppT5). snRNA only here; M localization of C4 PEPC is textbook C4 biochemistry (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Carbonic anhydrase (UniProt A0A1B6Q4X6), supplies HCO3- to PEPC; paper annotation marker; M 48.0 vs BS 2.5 (SuppT9, sharpest M/BS contrast); M log2FC 1.63 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Pyruvate,Pi dikinase (UniProt A0A1B6P8M2), C4 M enzyme; M 52.6 vs BS 18.3 (SuppT9); M log2FC 1.70 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots). Same ID in skill core sorghum_leaf.tsv as PPDK (Mesophyll) (lab curation, not an independent study; no raise)
Triose-phosphate isomerase (UniProt C5X695); M 9.6 vs BS 1.6 (SuppT9), M log2FC 0.91; fits C4 triose-P shuttle in M (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
PPDK regulatory protein (UniProt A0A1W0W6N8); M 1.86 vs BS 0.31 (SuppT9); low expression (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

LHCB (UniProt A0A1W0VYB5); paper annotation marker but weak (M 1.12 vs BS 0.43; pct ratio 1.4); LHC genes are high in all green nuclei, use only as support (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

C4 NADP-malic enzyme (UniProt C5XM00 Malic enzyme); BS 19.4 vs M 3.5 (SuppT9); BS log2FC 1.86; promoter BS-accessible (ED Fig 4f). NOTE paper dotplot/SuppT1 list Sobic.003G002600 as NADPME, which is a MYB-domain gene (UniProt A0A1W0VV80); use this ID (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots). Same ID in skill core sorghum_leaf.tsv as NADP-ME (Bundle_Sheath) (lab curation, not an independent study; no raise)

Glycine decarboxylase P protein (UniProt C5YS41); paper annotation marker (GDC); BS log2FC 1.34, pct ratio 2.9; photorespiratory GDC confined to BS in C4 grasses (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Glycine cleavage H protein (UniProt C5YT80); BS 7.1 vs M 1.3 (SuppT9), BS log2FC 1.01 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Glycolate oxidase (UniProt C5WY71); BS 8.5 vs M 1.1 (SuppT9), BS log2FC 1.27 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
RuBisCO small subunit (UniProt C5Y519); BS 69 vs M 25.6 (only 2.7x in nuclei; high in all green nuclei); BS log2FC 1.28 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Dicarboxylate translocator DIT2.1 best hit (paper annotation; UniProt C5XUI4 uncharacterized); BS log2FC 1.65, pct ratio 3.7; malate import into BS chloroplast (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Phosphoribulokinase (UniProt A0A194YRT4); BS 6.6 vs M 2.7 (SuppT9) (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Alanine aminotransferase/GGT (UniProt A0A1B6Q8L5); BS log2FC 0.73, pct ratio 2.7; cluster 4 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Uncharacterized (UniProt A0A1B6Q8B0); strongest BS/M contrast in SuppT9 (BS 23.7 vs M 1.7); BS log2FC 2.12; listed as MEP in the C4 category of SuppT9 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Dof TF (UniProt A0A194YT63); transactivated sorghum GAPDH promoter in rice protoplasts (Fig 5c); BS-enriched (pct ratio 2.9, also phloem 2.4) (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

R2R3-MYB, best hit AtMYB36 (paper annotation; UniProt C5YV34 uncharacterized); BS cluster 4, pct ratio 4.1; endodermis-like regulator hypothesis, untested (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Suberin omega-hydroxylase (Ensembl ortholog AT5G23190 CYP86B1); BS log2FC 2.13, cluster 15 only (suberized BS subpopulation) (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Suberin GPAT (Ensembl ortholog AT3G11430 GPAT5); BS log2FC 1.23, cluster 15 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

bHLH (UniProt A0A1B6PAB9), best hit AtFAMA (paper annotation); guard cluster 14 only, pct ratio 18.2, log2FC 1.77; FAMA drives GC differentiation in grasses. Marks young GC/GMC (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Slow anion channel (Ensembl ortholog AT1G12480 SLAC1; UniProt A0A1Z5REL8 uncharacterized); paper annotation marker; pct ratio 15.4 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Outward K+ channel (Ensembl orthologs AT5G37500 GORK, AT3G02850 SKOR); paper annotation marker; pct ratio 6.9 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
SnRK2 kinase (UniProt C5WT44 Ser/Thr kinase); paper annotation marker; pct ratio 4.65 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
UniProt C5Y4R2 Transcription factor MYB60; AtMYB60 is GC-specific; pct ratio 15.1, cluster 14 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Ser/Thr kinase (UniProt C5Z6K7), best hit AtHT1 (CO2 control of stomata); pct ratio 17.4, cluster 14 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Wax aldehyde decarbonylase (UniProt A0A1Z5RRB7 aldehyde oxygenase; Ensembl CER1/CER1-like orthologs); paper annotation marker; in cluster 6 top-200 but not in SuppT5 DE list (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
HD-ZIP IV best hit AtHDG11 (paper annotation; UniProt C5XTH9 uncharacterized); epidermis pct ratio 4.8, clusters 5/6/17 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
HD-ZIP IV best hit AtHDG2 (paper annotation; UniProt C5YG87 uncharacterized); epidermis pct ratio 4.5, clusters 6/8/17 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
UniProt A0A1W0VRU8 Protodermal factor 1 domain; epidermis pct ratio 3.3, cluster 6 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase (UniProt C5X1L0), cuticular wax elongation; epidermis log2FC 2.04, pct ratio 4.3 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (UniProt C5WZC2); xylem log2FC 3.29, pct ratio 12.9, cluster 10 only; may also mark fibres (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots). Also xylem-enriched (scRNA only, no raise) in sorghum root (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature)

Secondary-wall cellulose synthase (UniProt C5XK44); xylem log2FC 3.43, pct ratio 13.9 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots). Raised medium->high: same ID validated by HCR in sorghum root xylem files (Guillotin et al. 2023 Nature ED Fig 8c; sorghum_root group), independent of Swift. Same ID in skill core sorghum_leaf.tsv as IRX1 (Xylem) (lab curation, not an independent study; no raise)

Xylem cysteine peptidase (Ensembl orthologs AT1G20850 XCP2, AT4G35350 XCP1); paper annotation marker; xylem pct ratio 16.2; TE autolysis (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
Laccase (UniProt C5YZ93), lignin polymerisation; xylem pct ratio 17.5 (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

SbSUT1 per paper table (UniProt C5WVY0 uncharacterized; no 1:1 Arabidopsis ortholog); phloem log2FC 3.14, pct ratio 5.1, clusters 9/12; sucrose loading in companion cells (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots). Same ID in skill core sorghum_leaf.tsv as SUT1 (Phloem_Companion) (lab curation, not an independent study; no raise)

PEBP, best hit AtFT (paper annotation; UniProt C5Z4I8 uncharacterized); phloem pct ratio 8.6, cluster 9 only (companion-cell-like) (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots). Same ID in skill core sorghum_leaf.tsv as FTL12 (Phloem) (lab curation, not an independent study; no raise)
Amino acid permease (Ensembl orthologs incl. AT1G77380 AAP3); phloem pct ratio 8.4, cluster 9 only (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)
UniProt C5Y0Q0 bidirectional sugar transporter SWEET; phloem pct ratio 4.0 (also in BS cluster 4) (Swift et al. 2024 Nature; snRNA de-etiolating seedling shoots)

Siliplant1, proline/lysine-rich protein that precipitates silica in grass leaf silica cells (Kumar et al. 2020 J Exp Bot); from survey characterized_markers.tsv (gaps brachypodium_leaf/maize_leaf:Silica), ID checked there by HKKPVPPKPKPEPK repeats; not covered by Swift 2024 (no silica cluster).
